title: Replay QA: { fully managed }
subtitle: End-to-end testing that explores, runs and records on its own
logline: You give Replay QA one URL. It explores your app, turns what it finds into journeys and runs them on a schedule, against staging, a preview or localhost, and on every pull request, recording every run. So when a bug only exists in time (a 67 ms commit nobody clicked, one list fetched 258 times), it arrives with a recording and its root cause.

vhs.subject: Software Testing
vhs.tagline: Catch the bugs that hide in time!

chapters.title: One URL
chapters.blurb: One address is the whole setup. The URL is typed full-frame over a blurred ghost of the real input (the kick enters on the caret's arrival as the whip lands), then pulls back into Replay QA's real New project page: braces on the input, the cursor hovering Start setup, just a quick chat.

chapters.title: The loop
chapters.blurb: The reference's 'Building Image' step list becomes 'Testing your app': the replay.io home page's three steps, verbatim (Explore / Test & Record / Investigate & Report), each green check clacking in as the narration names the mechanism while 'Working' shimmers and turns to 'Done', with one small grey line of Insights proof (89 explorations, 1151 journeys). Then the rows break into square registration dots that clear to bare paper, and the cut lands straight into ch04 on M3's first downbeat. 'Recorded' is first said aloud in ch04 and 'root cause' in ch06's closing triplet.

shots.visual: The reference's 'Building Image' step list, re-made for Replay QA. A blur dissolve from ch02's floating new-project screen lands on bare studio paper (#e9e8ea), lots of negative space, two hairlines drifting slowly across the frame. Composition: the whole list (title, rows, proof line, Working/Done) sits in the LEFT TWO-THIRDS of the frame only, top-left anchored like the reference; the right third stays bare paper. At the top left the title 'Testing your app' (Promo Sans regular, 46 px, slightly tight tracking, sentence case) resolves from a 12 px blur to sharp over 0.5 s. Under it a thin vertical hairline spine draws downward (kit steps) and three step rows arrive one after another, 0.15 s apart, each sliding up 8 px and un-blurring: a small line icon in a pale circle (map / film strip / bug), the label in near-black Promo Sans regular 32 px, and under it a grey detail line at 22 px (never smaller: row three's meaning rides on its detail line). These are the replay.io home page's three steps VERBATIM (Explore · Test & Record · Investigate & Report); never mix them with the docs' five-step list. Grey details: 'an AI agent drives your app in a real browser' / 'every journey run, a Replay recording' / 'root cause for every bug'. As the first check lands, one small grey proof line (Promo Sans, 20 px, tabular figures, unspoken) fades in under the list, left-aligned to the labels: 'Insights: 89 explorations · 1151 journeys' (the exact figures on the Insights take's tiles; keep the 'Insights:' source tag, never 'in the account'). Bottom left, small, a shimmering 'Working' (a soft light sweep running through the word, as in the reference) sits until the last check. As each step is named, its pale circle fills and a green (#1f9d63) check mark draws itself over the icon in 0.18 s, the row's label darkens a notch, and the music lands one muted percussive clack (machines clack, never chime): on 'explores' row one; on 'journeys' row two (its film-strip icon advances one frame as the check draws); and row three on 'runs', the line's last stressed word (no word of its own: its grey detail line already reads 'root cause for every bug'). On that third check 'Working' stops shimmering and swaps to 'Done' in green, held still and readable through the end of the line and the hold. From 0.5 s after the line ends, the three resolved rows and the proof line break up from their right edges into a grid of small square registration dots (the look's squareDots) that scatter and clear to bare studio paper, 'Done' last; M2's one-bar fill runs under that hold, and the cut into ch04-s01 (also bare studio paper) lands on the bar line so M3's first downbeat arrives with it. No product footage in this shot or chapter, no quotation marks, and no numbers other than the one grey Insights line. Never show more steps than these three.

chapters.title: Always on
chapters.blurb: One rhythmic triplet, each proof landing on a downbeat with a filtered stab and a brace snap. 'Then it runs on Replay's browsers': the real 'Tue at 3:00 AM · America/New_York' chip lifts under a large thin 3:00 AM like a name tag, a 'hosted by Replay' pill lands on 'browsers', and six ticks mark the six Tuesdays it really fired. Three environment words lift off the real Add environment row as pills and light red-pink as they are said. The Reminders · CI runs table, braces on the first blue PR #3 badge, an 'a test run for every PR' pill, and a ▶ recording chip popping out of every visible run row as each run is recorded, then reviewed, for what's slow as well as what breaks.

chapters.title: Bugs that only exist in time
chapters.blurb: The one plum register: a 67 ms commit nobody clicked on Replay QA's own Projects page, where 25 of 27 renders changed nothing a screen recording could see; a sync loop that fetched one pull-request list 258 times in under three minutes because it never saved its place; and, in a corner, a developer handing a recording to a critic until it says good.

shots.setting: the brand haze (deep plum, Replay red-pink, violet), an abstract studio, 2026, no time of day: the film's one dark register

lines.text: Some bugs only exist in time.
lines.direction: slower and lower than everything before it; the room has gone dark. Let 'in time' sit a fraction apart, not dramatic, just certain NARRATION (2026-10-14): take ran 235 wpm against 'slower and lower'; solo re-take at 0.98, the ellipsis sets 'in time' a fraction apart (text unchanged).

chapters.title: { fully managed · always on }
chapters.blurb: A collage of four real product tiles with the line to remember woven between them in three even rows, then the ember end card: Replay QA, end-to-end testing, fully managed; catch bugs that only exist in time.

shots.setting: light-grey studio paper (#e9e8ea), an abstract studio, 2026, no time of day; frozen product tiles fanned at different depths

lines.text: Every run, a recording. Every bug, a root cause. Every fix, rerun to confirm.
lines.direction: the line to remember: three even steps, each landing on a downbeat; warm, a touch brighter on 'confirm'. NARRATION (2026-10-14, round-1 review): the take ran 194 wpm with the steps running together; re-take solo at speed 0.94 with a clear breath (about 0.35 s in all) after 'recording' and after 'cause', aiming for about 165 wpm.

shots.visual: The reference's fanned photo collage, made of real product. A cut from ch05-s04's bug-sync strip: it becomes tile (D) as FOUR frozen RrwebScreen tiles (all cursor={false}) on paper at three depths (soft shadows, tilts between -12 and +12 deg about y, a slow 3 % push-in across the shot, the tiles drifting apart a few px), each cropped to one readable detail and never showing the chat column, the project tab strip, the owner's sidebar footer, the credit meter or the budget. READING PATH: the woven words sit on THREE ROWS in reading order, one step of the line per row: the 'every X' phrase in the LEFT lane (left edge ≈ x 90) and its answer in the RIGHT lane (left edge ≈ x 700) on the SAME baseline: row 1 baseline y ≈ 200, row 2 y ≈ 370, row 3 y ≈ 540, so the line reads as three parallel steps, top to bottom, left then right. The tiles sit only in the gaps between rows, never under or over a word (layout on the 1280 x 720 stage). TOP BAND (above row 1): (A) left ≈ x 70-590, y 85-145: take insights frozen at stats mark 2926, crop ≈ {x: 330, y: 160, w: 860, h: 100}, the Insights stat tiles exactly as recorded (50 Projects · 711 Total Bugs · 29% Resolution Rate · 1151 Journeys · 89 Explorations), with a small grey 'Insights' label on the card (unspoken; the Discovery Source card is never in crop; cursor={false}, since at 2926 the recorded cursor sits on 'TOTAL BUGS'); (B) right ≈ x 660-1100, y 36-167: take runs frozen at list mark 3668, crop {x: 500, y: 112, w: 940, h: 280} (as ch04-s03: it starts below the project tab strip, so no half-cut tabs or count badge along its top edge), the Test Runs table's Description / Environment / Status columns with the purple 'PR #3' badge. MIDDLE BAND (between rows 1 and 2, y ≈ 230-325): (C) left ≈ x 70-560: take bug-react frozen at 3150, chips row + title with the 'Open' chip (the crop holds only the chips and title; the player panel is never in crop), with a small grey 'Replay QA's own Projects page' label on the card's top-left corner; (D) right ≈ x 680-1170: take bug-sync frozen at report mark 1603, chips row + title with the 'Fixed' chip. The band between rows 2 and 3 and the strip below row 3 stay open paper with kit hairlines, so the fix row has no tile beside or above it and never reads as a caption on the bug-sync 'Fixed' tile (row 2 and a band of paper separate them). The kinetic words are drawn in the DOM/SVG overlay ABOVE the tiles (never on the canvas under them): Promo Sans regular 44 px, ink on paper, each blurring in on its spoken word with the white → peach → orange colour sweep on its tail: row 1 'every run' (left) · 'a recording' (right, under the runs tile); row 2 'every bug' (left, under the bug-react tile) · 'a root cause' (right, under the bug-sync tile); row 3 'every fix' (left) · 'rerun to confirm' (right, the largest, 52 px, ≈ x 700-1130). On 'Every' in rows 1 and 2 the two tiles just above that row lift a few px toward camera (transform on the tile's wrapper); on row 3 the runs tile lifts once more. In the last second a small '▶ recording' chip drifts out of the runs tile down through the open band toward frame centre (it will settle beside the Replay mark on the end card), and the whole collage begins to blur and sink: the DOM tiles blur and sink through their own style filter: blur() and transform, since the canvas blur transition does not reach DOM layers. THE SUBTLE BEAT (moved here on the director's note, 2026-10-14: the standalone ch05-s05 agent shot was cut): under the woven words, in the open paper strip BELOW row 3 (y ≈ 600-700, never touching a word or a tile), the developer ↔ critic agent pair (sets/ch05-s05-pair.ts, the existing local pair) plays small and quiet (scale ≈ 0.5, centred near x ≈ 640, about 40 % opacity rising to 70 %) while the narrator talks about other things: it is never named, never the headline. It eases in on 'Every' (w1); exchange 1 (a '▶ replay recording' chip slides developer → critic) on 'recording', the critic answers '✕ not yet'; exchange 2 on 'fix', the critic answers '✓ good' landing on or just before 'confirm', so the pair quietly illustrates 'rerun to confirm'. It fades with the collage at the end. No 'illustration' tag needed at this size; nothing implies the agents fixed a specific bug (the 'Fixed' tile D sits well above it).
